name: 45822 · Celina, OH
findings: ZIP 45822 (Celina) has 74 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45822 (Celina) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45822 (Celina) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).
